text_sheet.text: GFCI FACEPLATE RECEPTACLE ABOVE COUNTER, COORDINATE MOUNTING HEIGHT WITH TENANT.HAND DRYER MOUNTED AT 42" AFF.PROVIDE A GFCI DUPLEX RECEPTACLE MOUNTED BELOW COUNTERTOP FOR CONNECTION OF AUTOMATIC FAUCET SENSOR. ENSURE PLUMBING PIPING WILL NOT INTERFERE WITH MOUNTING LOCATION AND COORDINATE ALL REQUIREMENTS WITH PLUMBING CONTRACTOR PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.HYDROMASSAGE UNIT. 208 VOLT, 30 AMP DEDICATED OUTLET WITH NEMA L6-30 LOCKING RECEPTACLE. IT ALSO REQUIRES A 120-VOLT, NEMA 5-15 RECEPTACLE FOR TOUCHSCREEN.TANNING AND HYBRID BED/BOOTH. 240 VOLTS, THREE PHASE, 40 AMP DEDICATED CIRCUIT. PROVIDE APPROXIMATELY 6 FEET OF #8 AWG WIRE OUT OF THE LEFT SIDE OF THE BACK PANEL THROUGH 1-INCH LIQUID TIGHT FLEX CONNECTOR. THIS WIRE MUST BE SLEEVED WITH FLEX AND BROUGHT INTO A JUNCTION BOX/DISCONNECT. THIS LENGTH OF WIRE IS NECESSARY TO MOVE THE UNIT FOR SERVICE.PROVIDE ISOLATED GROUND FOR CHECK-IN COMPUTER/PRINTER RECEPTACLES. POWER AND DATA SHALL RUN IN TRENCH BELOW CHECK IN AREA, COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION WITH ARCHITECTURAL PLANS. POWER AND DATA SHALL RUN IN SEPARATE CONDUITS.PHONE JACK AND RECEPTACLE FOR T-MAX MANAGER TANNING BED CONTROL. WIRE TO TIMER AT EACH TANNING ROOM AS REQUIRED. SEE LOW VOLTAGE PLAN ON SHEET E-600 FOR T-MAX TIMER LOCATIONS. PROVIDE A SINGLE GANG BOX SHIELDED CAT-5 FROM TMAX CONTROLLER AT DESK THROUGH EACH GANG BOX, TERMINATE IN LAST ROOM.LOCATION OF DATA RACK AND TELEVISION DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM. COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION OF RECEPTACLES WITH A/V VENDOR.COORDINATE TV MOUNTING HEIGHT AND CONNECTION REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.MOUNT RECEPTACLE SERVING DRINKING FOUNTAIN BELOW UNIT PER MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE.POWER AND DATA SHALL BE RAN ABOVE FLOOR FROM END OF STAR-LINE RACEWAY TO NEAREST COLUMN OR FULL HEIGHT WALL. COORDINATE EXACT REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO ORDER AND/OR INSTALLATION. PROVIDE SEPARATE CONDUIT/RACEWAYS FOR POWER. COMPLY WITH NEC 310.15. ENSURE ALL WIRE BETWEEN COLUMN AND RACEWAY JUNCTION BOX IS PROTECTED.COORDINATE CLUB COMM CONNECTIONS WITH LOW VOLTAGE VENDOR.BEVERAGE COOLER, PROVIDE DEDICATED RECEPTACLE ON GFCI CIRCUIT BREAKER PER MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS.PLANET FITNESS CLOCK, COORDINATE LOCATION AND MOUNTING HEIGHT WITH TENANT. COORDINATE ELECTRICAL REQUIREMENTS WITH FAN MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN. PROVIDE CEILING FAN-RATED MOUNTING BOX WITH A SAFETY BRACE HAVING A MINIMUM LOAD RATING OF 70 LBS.

ANY EXISTING CONDITIONS INDICATED IN THIS SET OF DRAWINGS ARE BASED ON INFORMATION PROVIDED BY OTHERS AND POSSIBLE LIMITED FIELD VERIFICATION. ADJUST FOR ACTUAL FIELD CONDITIONS AT NO ADDITIONAL EXPENSE TO THE OWNER.VISIT THE PROJECT SITE, REVIEW EXISTING CONDITIONS AGAINST THE CONTRACT DOCUMENTS, AND BECOME FAMILIAR WITH THE WORK PRIOR TO BIDDING AND START OF THE WORK. SIGNING THE CONTRACT IS AN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT THAT THE SITE VISIT HAS BEEN COMPLETED AND THE EXISTING CONDITIONS ARE ACCEPTED.DEMOLISH ANY EXISTING EQUIPMENT, DEVICES, AND LUMINAIRES AS INDICATED AND/OR AS REQUIRED TO ALLOW FOR INSTALLATION AND CONSTRUCTION OF THE NEW WORK. REMOVE ALL EQUIPMENT, DEVICES, LUMINAIRES, CONDUITS, SUPPORTS, HANGERS, ETC. THAT ARE NOT SHOWN AND ARE REQUIRED TO BE REMOVED IN ORDER TO COMPLETE THE NEW WORK.ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS THAT ARE TO BE REMOVED SHALL BE REMOVED IN THEIR ENTIRETY. CONDUCTORS SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE ITEM TO BE DEMOLISHED TO THE SOURCE OF OVERCURRENT PROTECTION. RACEWAYS WHICH ARE INSTALLED IN OR BELOW FLOORS OR WITHIN WALLS MAY BE ABANDONED, BUT ALL OVERHEAD OR EXPOSED RACEWAYS SHALL BE REMOVED. EXPOSED RACEWAYS TO BE ABANDONED SHALL BE REMOVED AND SHALL BE CUT OR CHISELED AT LEAST 2" INTO THE WALL OR FLOOR AND THE OPENING GROUTED SMOOTH.THE OWNER SHALL HAVE SALVAGE RIGHTS TO ANY ITEMS THAT ARE TO BE DEMOLISHED. THOSE ITEMS THAT THE OWNER WISHES TO SALVAGE SHALL BE CAREFULLY REMOVED AND STORED IN A LOCATION AS DIRECTED BY THE OWNER. ALL OTHER ITEMS OF DEMOLITION SHALL BECOME THE PROPERTY OF THE CONTRACTOR AND SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE SITE.PROVIDE TEMPORARY CIRCUITS AND CONNECTIONS TO EQUIPMENT, LUMINAIRES, OR DEVICES IN AREAS OF THE FACILITY THAT ARE TO REMAIN IN OPERATION AS REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN THOSE AREAS IN COMPLETE OPERATION.MAINTAIN CONTINUITY OF EXISTING CIRCUITS AS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE POWER TO REMAINING EQUIPMENT AND DEVICES THAT ARE NOT BEING REMOVED.PROVIDE BLANK COVERPLATES FOR EXISTING EMPTY DEVICE BOXES OR JUNCTION BOXES THAT MUST REMAIN, SUCH AS FOR CIRCUITS THAT MUST BE MAINTAINED TO OTHER AREAS.WHERE ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT (PANELBOARDS, SWITCHBOARDS, ETC.) IS TO BE REMOVED OR RELOCATED, ALL EXISTING CIRCUITS THAT ARE TO REMAIN SHALL BE RECONNECTED TO NEW OR RELOCATED ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT TO MAINTAIN THE CONTINUITY OF THOSE EXISTING CIRCUITS. INTERCEPT AND EXTEND ALL EXISTING CIRCUITS AS REQUIRED. REMOVE ALL ABANDONED TELECOMMUNICATIONS CABLING.Dry-type transformers installed indoors and rated 112 1/2 kVA or less shall have a separation of at least 300 mm (12 in.) from combustible material unless separated from the combustible material by a fire-resistant, heat-insulated barrier.Transformer top surfaces that are horizontal and readily accessible shall be marked to prohibit storage.
PANIC HARDWARE SHALL BE PROVIDED FOR ELECTRICAL ROOM DOOR.
